title: Orthonormality of Hermite functions
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every pair of multi-indices $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb N^n$, the inner product in Gaussian $L^2(\mathbb R^n)$ of their normalized multivariate Hermite functions is $1$ if $\alpha=\beta$ and $0$ otherwise.
